title: Noise decreases cube variance
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and $0\leq\rho\leq1$. For the Fourier noise operator $T_\rho$, the variance under the uniform measure satisfies $\operatorname{Var}(T_\rho f)\leq\operatorname{Var}(f)$.
